# Where to Watch Dot Conner: Webtective - The Series


by Angel | October 15, 2026


Meet Dot Conner, the world’s first (and only) webtective! Armed with her trusty notebook, detective skills, and unshakable faith, Dot teams up with her best friends to investigate the mysteries hiding in everyday life. From science fair scandals to debate dilemmas and confusing hiking trails, no case is too ordinary—or too puzzling—for this crew.


With humor, friendship, and faith woven into every investigation, *Dot Conner: Webtective – The Series* offers a fresh take on kids’ entertainment.[Watch the series now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/dot-conner-webtective-the-series)


### **Meet the World’s First Webtective**


Dot Conner isn’t your typical detective.


Instead of chasing down international criminals, she and her friends tackle the kinds of mysteries kids encounter in their own lives. A confusing situation? A problem that doesn’t have an obvious answer? A mystery that needs a little research? Dot is ready to investigate.


With her fedora and notebook in hand, she approaches each case with curiosity, determination, and a willingness to follow the clues wherever they lead.


Her approach encourages kids to ask questions, look for evidence, and think critically rather than simply accept the first answer they hear. After all, good detectives know that finding the truth takes more than a hunch.


### **Finding Truth Along the Way**


For Dot, solving a mystery isn’t only about figuring out what happened. It’s also about learning how to recognize and pursue the truth.


Her faith is an essential part of how she approaches each case. As Dot and her friends investigate, they discover how biblical principles can help them think through difficult questions, make wise choices, and understand the world around them.


Rather than separating faith from everyday life, the series brings the two together through situations kids can recognize. The result is an opportunity to explore Christian ideas through stories that are entertaining, relatable, and full of curiosity.


### **A Fresh Take on Faith-Filled Kids’ Entertainment**


With its detective-inspired premise, relatable mysteries, and genuine Christian insight, *Dot Conner: Webtective – The Series* offers something a little different from the usual kids’ show.


The series combines the fun of solving puzzles with meaningful lessons about faith, truth, and decision-making. It gives kids room to be curious, encourages them to think critically, and shows how biblical principles can apply to real-life situations.


For families looking for a series that entertains while giving kids something meaningful to think about, Dot’s investigations offer plenty to explore.


The next case is waiting.[Stream Dot Conner: Webtective – The Series now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/dot-conner-webtective-the-series)
